title: Deno Desktop
summary: Deno Desktop is a feature that enables building desktop applications using the Deno runtime environment, bringing Deno's secure-by-default model and native TypeScript support to desktop development. It connects Deno with desktop frameworks like Tauri, allowing developers to create cross-platform applications using web technologies.
problem_solved: Enables developers to build secure, cross-platform desktop applications using familiar web technologies with Deno's security-first approach and TypeScript support.
why_valuable: It unifies the Deno development experience across server and desktop, offering TypeScript-first development with built-in security permissions for native applications.
